# Lootifications

Lootifications is an addon for World of Warcraft that shows notifications for loot and money, and keeps a log of them.

![Notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moody/Lootifications/main/.github/images/Lootifications.gif)

## Features

- Notifications for items and money, with the item's icon and quantity
- Optional vendor price and bag count in item notifications
- Choose which way the notifications grow and how they line up, and drag them anywhere on the screen
- A log of the items and money looted this session, with totals
- A minimap icon and chat commands

### Options

The options are on the `Settings` tab of the main window. The window remembers where you move it, and Shift and right-click on it resets its position.

- **Money** — Show a notification when money is looted or received
- **Item Prices** — Include the vendor price of items in loot notifications
- **Bag Counts** — Include how many of the item are in your bags in loot notifications
- **Text Size** — The size of the notification text, from 8 to 32 pixels
- **Background** — The background and border of the notifications:
  - `None`: no background or border
  - `Subtle`: a faint background and border, both 30% opaque
  - `High Contrast`: a 95% opaque background, and a solid border in the item's quality color, or the color of the largest coin for money
- **Direction** — Grow down from the anchor's top or up from its bottom
- **Alignment** — Line the notifications up to the left, center, or right
- **Minimap Icon** — Show an icon on the minimap

`Reset to Defaults` resets every option and the anchor's position.

![Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moody/Lootifications/main/.github/images/Settings.png)

### Anchor

The anchor is where the notifications appear. While the `Settings` tab is open, it plays sample notifications in a loop. Drag it to move the notifications, and right-click it to reset its position. Loot notifications are not shown meanwhile, but the loot is still recorded in the log.

![Anchor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moody/Lootifications/main/.github/images/Anchor.png)

### Log

The `Log` tab, which the main window starts on, lists the items and money looted this session, newest first.

- Each item shows its icon, link, quantity, and how long ago it was looted, and hovering it shows its tooltip
- A bar under the list shows the total number of items, counting each item in a stack, and the total money
- `Clear Log` empties the list and the totals, and clears the notifications on screen or waiting
- The log is not saved between sessions

![Log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moody/Lootifications/main/.github/images/Log.png)

### Minimap Icon

- Left-click toggles the `Log`
- Right-click toggles the `Settings`

The `Minimap Icon` option hides it.

## Chat Commands

`/lootifications` can be used in place of `/lootif`.

```bash
# Toggle the main window.
/lootif

# Display a list of commands.
/lootif help
```

# Changelog

## [2.0.0] - 2026-10-27

### Breaking

- Settings were reset.

### Added

- Added a Log tab to the options window, which starts on it. It lists the items and money looted this session, newest first, with each entry's quantity or amount and how long ago it was, and shows item and money totals. Hovering an item shows its tooltip, and Clear Log empties the log and clears its notifications. The log is not saved between sessions.
- Added a minimap icon. Left-click toggles the Log and right-click toggles the Settings. The Minimap Icon option in the Settings hides it.
- Added Direction (down or up) and Alignment (left, center or right) options for the notifications, which were chosen by where the anchor was placed, and a Reset to Defaults button.
- Added a Text Size option for the notifications, a slider from 8 to 32 pixels.
- Added a Background option for the notifications: None, Subtle (as before), or High Contrast, which darkens the background and colors the border by item quality, or by the largest coin for money.
- The options window now remembers where it was moved. Shift and right-click on it resets its position.
- Added the `/lootif` slash command as a short form of `/lootifications`.
- Added `/lootif help`, which lists the commands.

### Changed

- Notifications show at most 5 at a time (was 10 by default) and are spaced to fit the text size, 6 pixels apart at the default size (was 4).
- Notifications fade in more slowly and appear 0.15 seconds apart. They slide in toward the stack, the others glide into their new places instead of jumping, and each drifts a little as it fades out.
- The notification anchor shows, with sample notifications that play in a loop, while the Settings tab is open, in place of the Toggle Anchor button. Right-click on the anchor resets its position instead of hiding it.
- Renamed the Money Notifications option to Money, Loot Prices to Item Prices, and Owned Item Counts to Bag Counts.

### Removed

- Removed the Max Notifications, Notification Alpha, Notification Fade-Out Delay, and Notification Spacing options.
- Removed the Toggle Anchor and Test Notifications buttons.

- Updated for Cataclysm Classic

## [1.4.0] - 2024-04-29

### Added

- Command: `/lootifications alpha <integer>` to set notification background transparency
- Command: `/lootifications alpha reset` to reset notification background transparency
- Command: `/lootifications space <integer>` to set the amount of spacing between displayed notifications
- Command: `/lootifications space reset` to reset the amount of spacing between displayed notifications

### Changed

- Refactored notification code

## [1.3.0] - 2024-01-03

### Added

- Command: `/lootifications prices` to toggle loot prices in notifications
- Command: `/lootifications delay reset` to reset the delay time before notifications fade out
- Command: `/lootifications max reset` to reset the maximum number of displayed notifications

## [1.2.0] - 2023-12-31

### Added

- Command: `/lootifications anchor` to toggle the notifications anchor
- Command: `/lootifications anchor reset` to reset the notifications anchor
- Command: `/lootifications delay <integer>` to set the delay time before notifications fade out
- Command: `/lootifications max <integer>` to set the maximum number of displayed notifications

## [1.1.1] - 2023-12-28

## [1.1.0] - 2023-12-25

### Added

- Command: `/lootifications test` to test notifications

### Fixed

- Notification bug for loot received by other players

## [1.0.0] - 2023-12-24

- Initial release
